title: Touchpoint
description: A single communication event between the show team and a guest or their representative, in either direction. Touchpoints build the correspondence history for an AppearanceOpportunity. Every touchpoint is logged before any follow-up logic runs. The system DRAFTS outbound messages; the human sends them. Incoming messages are logged automatically from inbox ingestion.

opportunity_id.description: The AppearanceOpportunity this touchpoint belongs to.

direction.description: Whether this was sent by the show team, received from the guest side, or an internal note.

timestamp.description: When this touchpoint occurred or was drafted.

sender.description: person_id or name of the sender.

recipient.description: person_id or name of the recipient.

summary.description: Brief factual summary of the touchpoint content. Auto-generated summaries must be flagged as such.

message_reference.description: External thread ID, email message-id, or document URL for the underlying message.

sentiment.description: Classified sentiment of the message. Only set after reply.classified event.

intent.description: Classified intent of an inbound reply. Drives next-action logic. AMBIGUOUS and REQUIRES_HUMAN always escalate to a human.

promises_detected.description: Free-text descriptions of any commitments detected in this message. Each should generate a Commitment record.

draft_approved_by.description: person_id of the human who approved this outbound draft before sending. Required for all outbound touchpoints.

sent_at.description: When the outbound message was actually sent by a human. Null if still a draft.
